english: Breaking a Combatant's Shield or performing a Finisher grants <pve 10% /> <pvp [2.5%] /> Damage Resist (Resist x1) and 100% increased Melee Damage for 6 seconds.

source.text:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Shield or performing a Finisher:

10% [2.5%] Damage Resist (Resist x1) for 6 seconds.
100% Increased Melee Damage for 6 seconds.
